entities.html:
inductive Tm : Type where
  | var : ℕ → Tm
  | and : Tm → Tm → Tm
  | imp :  Tm → Tm → Tm
  | tt  : Tm
entities.htmlGroup:
inductive Tm : Type where
  | var : ℕ → Tm
  | and : Tm → Tm → Tm
  | imp :  Tm → Tm → Tm
  | tt  : Tm
open Tm
scoped infixr:35 " ∧ " => Tm.and
scoped infixr:25 " ⇒ " => Tm.imp
entities.name: Kripke.Syntax.Tm.imp

entities.html: abbrev Ctxt := List Tm
entities.htmlGroup: abbrev Ctxt := List Tm
entities.name: Kripke.Syntax.Ctxt

entities.html:
inductive Pf : (Γ : Ctxt) → Tm → Prop where
  | assume : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P : Tm} , Pf (P :: Γ ) P
  | wk : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ P → Pf (Q :: Γ) P
  | and_I : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ P → Pf Γ Q → Pf Γ (P ∧ Q)
  | and_E₁ : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ∧ Q) → Pf Γ P
  | and_E₂ : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ∧ Q) → Pf Γ Q
  | imp_I :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf (P :: Γ) Q → Pf Γ (P ⇒ Q)
  | imp_E :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ⇒ Q) → Pf Γ P → Pf Γ Q
  | tt_I :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt}, Pf Γ tt
entities.htmlGroup:
inductive Pf : (Γ : Ctxt) → Tm → Prop where
  | assume : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P : Tm} , Pf (P :: Γ ) P
  | wk : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ P → Pf (Q :: Γ) P
  | and_I : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ P → Pf Γ Q → Pf Γ (P ∧ Q)
  | and_E₁ : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ∧ Q) → Pf Γ P
  | and_E₂ : ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ∧ Q) → Pf Γ Q
  | imp_I :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf (P :: Γ) Q → Pf Γ (P ⇒ Q)
  | imp_E :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt} {P Q : Tm}, Pf Γ (P ⇒ Q) → Pf Γ P → Pf Γ Q
  | tt_I :  ∀ {Γ : Ctxt}, Pf Γ tt
entities.name: Kripke.Syntax.Pf.imp_I

entities.html:
def example1 : Pf [] ((var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0 ⇒ var 1) := by
⊢ Pf [] ((var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0 ⇒ var 1)

  apply Pf.imp_I
a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] (var 1)

  apply Pf.imp_E
a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] (?a.P✝ ⇒ var 1)
a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] ?a.P✝
a.P
⊢ Tm

  ·
a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] (?a.P✝ ⇒ var 1)
 apply Pf.and_E₁
a.a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] ((?a.P✝ ⇒ var 1) ∧ ?a.a.Q✝)
a.a.Q
⊢ Tm

    apply Pf.assume
  ·
a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] ?a.P✝
 apply Pf.and_E₂
a.a.a
⊢ Pf [(var 0 ⇒ var 1) ∧ var 0] (?a.a.P✝ ∧ var 0)
a.a.P
⊢ Tm

    apply Pf.assume
